metadata.Short Title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
metadata.Long Title: An Act to provide protection against sexual harassment of women at workplace and for the prevention and redressal of complaints of sexual harassment and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
metadata.Notification: 9th December, 2013, vide notification No. S.O. 3606(E), dated 9th December, 2013, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
